text:
marta: Heads up — ap-southeast-4 GPU cluster is provisioned (4xA100 equiv). Need a quick security baseline check before handing to Platform. Specifically: IAM/service identities, secrets delivery (Vault), KMS/HSM integration, node-level least-privilege, egress controls, and any policy gating for Dedicated workloads. Who can run the validations today? :eyes:
vikram: I can take the IAM and KMS checks. I'll need the cluster name and the KMS key alias.
leah: I ran a quick smoke on node bootstrapping — nodes join ok but kubelet logs show an auth warning I want to dig into. I can help with node identity.
sandeep: I can do Vault & secrets plumbing. Confirming we used Vault-transit with auto-unseal via HSM?
marta: Yes — auto-unseal via hsm-key: projects/redwood-kms/locations/ap-east/keyRings/ri-hsm/cryptoKeys/auto-unseal. Vault backend deployed in the control plane VPC with peering to the cluster VPC.
vikram: Cool. First IAM sanity: ensure node service account only has compute.instance* and limited kms:Decrypt on the node keyring, and no broad storage access. Run this quick check: ```gcloud iam roles list --project redwood-prod | grep compute``` and inspect binding for the node SA.
ops-bot: deploy-check: IAM bindings scan completed for project redwood-prod — 2 findings. Shortlist: node-sa has roles/storage.objectViewer (unexpected).
vikram: That's the one. Node SA should not read bucket objects by default. @albert can you confirm why storage.objectViewer was added? Might be a copy from gpu-init scripts.
albert: That binding came from a legacy provisioner (gpu-init role). I can remove the binding and replace with a minimal custom role "roles/ri.nodeMinimal" that contains only compute.instances.get/list and kms.decrypt for the node key. I will submit PR to infra-roles.
sandeep: For Vault: validate secrets injection path and RBAC. Steps I ran: ```kubectl -n kube-system get sa ri-kv-injector -o yaml``` then validated the Vault policy with ```vault policy read cluster-gpu-apse4```. Policy looks okay but token TTL was 72h — we should lower to 2h for nodes.
leah: The kubelet auth warning I saw: "kubelet: anonymous access disabled but client cert not presented". Looks like the node bootstrapping script didn't upload the node cert to the CA. Command I used to inspect: ```kubectl --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf get nodes -o wide``` — node appears Ready but the kubelet logs show intermittent cert refresh errors.
vikram: Can you paste the kubelet log snippet?
leah: ```
May 12 03:12:01 kubelet[1234]: E0502 03:12:01.123456    1234 server.go:123] unable to load client certificate: cert pool has no certs
May 12 03:12:01 kubelet[1234]: I0502 03:12:02.654321    1234 certificate_manager.go:456] Rotating client cert since it's not valid yet
```
vikram: Probable cause: the node metadata server IAM role couldn't call the CA signer. Check that the node service account has iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob or the cluster CA signer role.
leah: Confirmed node-sa lacked signBlob. Adding that to the minimal role now.
security-bot: policy-check: KMS key policy audit completed. Found: key rotation disabled for auto-unseal key. Recommendation: enable rotation and document key custody.
marta: Hmm — we intentionally used HSM-backed key but skipped rotation during bootstrap. Is rotation compatible with HSM auto-unseal?
vikram: Yes, KMS rotation is supported but coordinate with the HSM vendor; enable automatic rotation every 90 days. I'll add a runbook note.
sandeep: Vault unseal flow test: I did `vault operator init` simulation against the HSM key and test-encrypt/decrypt. Sample command: ```vault write transit/encrypt/ri-auto-unseal plaintext=$(echo -n secret | base64) key=auto-unseal``` — decrypt worked. I noted audit log entries in the KMS audit sink.
marta: Good. Next: egress & network policy. We need to ensure GPU nodes only egress to whitelisted registries and the Vault/KMS endpoints. Any deviation?
albert: Network ACLs: outbound 443 allowed to aws.eks.ecr and gcr.io ranges, but I found a CIDR open to 0.0.0.0/0 for corporate proxies. That was added for initial image pulls. We should lock it down and create a pull-through proxy in the infra VPC.
leah: Also suggest adding a policy to block instance metadata v1 on nodes and enforce IMDSv2. Quick check: ```curl -sS -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600' -X PUT \"http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token\"``` returned token — node metadata already supports v2 but metadata service wasn't enforced.
vikram: Action items I have: (1) remove storage.objectViewer from node-sa, (2) add iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob to node role, (3) enable key rotation for HSM auto-unseal key and add runbook. I'll PR infra-roles and open a KMS change request. ETA 4h.
sandeep: I'll reduce Vault token TTL to 2h and add an automated rotation job for Vault leases. I'll also add a post-provision test harness that runs: ```vault token-create -policy=cluster-gpu-apse4 -ttl=2h``` then attempts a secret read.
albert: I'll lock outbound ACLs and deploy a pull-through registry. Will coordinate maintenance window with Platform.
marta: Great — assign follow-ups here. Once all green, we'll do a formal handoff to Platform with the checklist: IAM, Vault, KMS rotation, node cert rotation, egress locked, IMDSv2 enforced, and documented runbook.
vikram: FYI I'll attach the IAM diff in the PR with commands used to validate: ```gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > before.json``` then after change produce `after.json` and run `git diff --no-index before.json after.json`.
ops-bot: task-tracker: Created ticket INFRA-APSE4-SEC-23 with checklist and owners (vikram/sandeep/albert). ETA: 1 business day for full validation. :white_check_mark:
marta: Thanks team. I'll do the final smoke once the infra PRs land. :thumbsup:
